issues.legal_issue: A councillor’s interest in a municipal lease does not disqualify the councillor from office unless the councillor acts in a councillor capacity in obtaining the lease.
material_facts: While serving as a councillor and president, the appellant applied directly to the municipality’s chief officer for temporary use of a plot to run a flour mill.
The chief officer granted permission subject to conditions, including that the plot be vacated whenever the municipality ordered.

The record did not show that the appellant performed a councillor’s statutory function in obtaining the plot. The possibility that the chief officer was influenced by the appellant’s position, and the president’s general supervisory authority over municipal officers, did not establish that the appellant acted as a councillor in the allotment.
issues.conclusion: The appellant was not disqualified on the facts shown. The appeal was allowed and the High Court’s judgment was set aside.
issues.legal_principle: Under section 38(1)(b)(i) of the Gujarat Municipalities Act, 1963, a councillor is disabled from continuing in office when the councillor acts as a councillor in a matter in which the councillor has a specified direct or indirect interest, including an interest in a lease. Section 11(3)(A)(i) provides that an interest in a lease of immovable property is not, by itself, a disqualification; section 38(1)(b)(i) applies where the councillor acts as a councillor in obtaining the lease. Sections 45 and 49, which provide for the president’s general supervision and the chief officer’s subordination to that control, do not make every application by a president amount to acting as a councillor. The words “acts as a councillor” require performance of a function the councillor is required to perform under the Act. No earlier cases are relied on in the judgment.

predicates.councillor_disqualification_proceeding: The matter is a proceeding to determine whether a councillor is disqualified from continuing in office.
predicates.municipal_lease_interest: The councillor obtained or sought an interest in a lease of property from the municipality.
predicates.no_councillor_function_performed: The councillor did not perform a statutory function of a councillor in the matter of obtaining the lease.
predicates.disqualification_not_triggered: The councillor is not disqualified from continuing in office on that basis.

issues.definition: When a disqualification proceeding concerns a councillor’s interest in a municipal lease, and the councillor performed no statutory councillor function in obtaining it, the disqualification is not triggered.
